context: Fix run.py to record the canonical 'notuning' mode when the user explicitly requested baseline, keeping genuinely-absent (user passed nothing) as the distinct not-recorded state. Trace one facet consumer end-to-end in a test so the distinction is pinned behaviorally, not just at the recording site. Update the schemas.py comment to the pinned vocabulary and confirm replay still round-trips both explicit notuning and absent.
description:
From the 2026-07-31 adversarial review (doc-vs-code sweep).

Defect (A8/D2): benchbox/cli/commands/run.py:359 records tuning_mode=None for an explicit --tuning notuning run. ADR-002 (docs/development/tuning-adr-002-mode-vocabulary-fallback-facets.md, section 2, lines 55-66) requires absent-vs-notuning to stay distinct ('never coerced'); the None coercion makes explicit baseline runs land in the NOT_RECORDED facet downstream and stop exact-matching other notuning runs in comparison surfaces.

Residue: benchbox/core/schemas.py:497 still carries the exact pre-decision comment ADR-002 quotes as the bug ('# "tuned", "notuning", "auto", or path'), documenting the outlawed vocabulary as current; schemas.py:550-551 replays tuning_mode verbatim as a --tuning argument (legitimate for path replay, but the comment must describe the pinned vocabulary from benchbox/core/tuning/modes.py).

Verified consistent while reviewing (do not churn): the vocabulary pin itself (modes.py), fallback labeling (tuning_resolver.py:152), and the --official refusal (run.py:138-158).

anti_patterns.dont: Do not default tuning_mode to 'notuning' whenever tuning is disabled
anti_patterns.instead: record 'notuning' only on explicit user request; keep None for genuinely absent
anti_patterns.why: that reverse-coerces the absent state ADR-002 protects and corrupts facets from the other direction

anti_patterns.dont: Do not fix only the comment and leave the None coercion
anti_patterns.why: the comment is residue; the coercion is the facet-corrupting defect

anti_patterns.dont: Do not migrate historical stored results as part of this change
anti_patterns.instead: fix the recording path; note the historical seam in the PR description
anti_patterns.why: back-population of facets is a separate data decision with its own blast radius

preserves.behavior: Absent (never specified) stays distinct from explicit notuning in every recorded artifact - the fix must not reverse-coerce absent into notuning.
ExecutionContext replay (schemas.py:550-551) keeps round-tripping path-based --tuning values byte-for-byte.
The pinned mode vocabulary in benchbox/core/tuning/modes.py is the single source of truth; no new mode strings are invented.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/cli tests/unit/core -q
verifications.expected: all pass including the new distinction tests
exit 0: comment replaced with pinned-vocabulary reference

work_units.evidence: Tests authored first. Pytest execution waited on live shared-lock holder, so equivalent direct uv probe established red behavior: explicit notuning collapsed to None and replay omitted --tuning notuning; absent assertion remained distinct. Probe exited 1 at the first explicit-notuning assertion.
work_units.notes: Add failing test: an explicit notuning invocation records tuning_mode='notuning' in the execution context / result metadata, while an invocation that never specifies tuning records the absent state; assert the two land in different facet values downstream.
work_units.summary: Failing test: explicit notuning records tuning_mode='notuning'; absent stays distinct; the two land in different facet values downstream

work_units.evidence: ExecutionContext recording now maps only the explicit canonical modes.NOTUNING request to notuning; absent remains None. Direct post-fix probe passed.

work_units.summary: Fix run.py:359 to record the canonical notuning mode on explicit request, sourced from modes.py

work_units.evidence: Schemas comment now points to the pinned modes module. Replay emits explicit --tuning notuning, omits absent, and preserves path-like values byte-for-byte; tests and direct probe cover all three. Official gate untouched.
work_units.notes: Replace the outlawed vocabulary comment at schemas.py:497 with the pinned vocabulary reference and add a replay round-trip test covering explicit notuning and absent.
